name: FamSMP
description:
Welcome to FamSMP — the family-friendly Bedrock survival server!

We're a brand-new community server built around one idea: survival Minecraft the way it should be — relaxed, welcoming and grief-free. Whether you're 8 or 48, playing on your phone, tablet or PC, there's a place for you on the coast.

What we offer:

- A stunning coastal world — spawn by the sea next to a plains village and a mysterious shipwreck

- True vanilla survival — no pay-to-win, no game-breaking plugins, achievements work!

- Family friendly — welcoming to younger players; no swearing, no griefing, no drama

- Cross-play — join from Windows 10/11, Android, iOS or Amazon Fire

- Fast UK/EU hosting — low ping for European players, online 24/7

- A growing community — get in early, claim your stretch of coastline and help shape the server

How to join: Add a server in Minecraft Bedrock with address famsmp.com and port 19132. That's it — see you on the beach!
